lines.zh: 我在草地上一窜一窜地跑。
lines.en: I dart across the grass in bursts.
The wind flips my petals back.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，花茎都在打弯。
lines.en: At a run, my stem bends with every stride.
I skim low over the ground.
I whip around the stone.

lines.zh: 月光下，我的花瓣张开了。
lines.en: Under moonlight, my petals open.

lines.zh: 花开在我头顶，一晃一晃。
lines.en: The bloom on my head sways.
I run so fast the wind falls behind.

lines.zh: 我夜里的影子拖得很长。
lines.en: My night shadow stretches long.
I slide down the slope, light as air.

lines.zh: 我一边跑一边闻着空气。
lines.en: I run while tasting the air.

lines.zh: 我转了个弯，草叶还没立起来。
lines.en: I turn, and the grass hasn't risen yet.

lines.zh: 我立在月光里，花瓣张着。
lines.en: I stand in the moonlight, petals open.
Night dew slides down my stem.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地摇晃，像被风吹。
lines.en: I sway slowly, as if in wind.
I listen for footsteps far off.
This bloom is at its best.
My roots shift quietly in the soil.
The moon goes behind cloud and I dim.
I wait for a certain scent to come near.
The dew on my petals is cold.

lines.zh: 我站得笔直，像朵普通的花。
lines.en: I stand straight, like any flower.

lines.zh: 花瓣对着月亮，我在算你还有几步。
lines.en: My petals face the moon while I count the steps you have left.
I open and close, slowly.
The night wind scatters my pollen.
I'm loveliest when I don't move.

lines.zh: 我看见很远的地方有个火把。
lines.en: I see a torch far away.
Wait a little; someone will come.
I turn my face to the moon.
This meadow blooms for me.
Your scent is sweet.
You come near, and my petals open.

lines.zh: 有那么一瞬间，你像花肥。
lines.en: For a moment you look like fertilizer.
I'm no ordinary flower.

lines.zh: 把我摘下来，你会看见我笑。
lines.en: Pick me and you will see me smile.
My eyes hide in the flower's heart.
Don't sniff; it'll make you dizzy.
When the moon is bright, I'm faster.
Just stand there. Don't move.
The flower may wilt; I remain.

lines.zh: 你看起来不太像个园丁。
lines.en: You don't look much like a gardener.

lines.zh: 我认得你走过的每一步。
lines.en: I know every step you've taken.
My petals are torn off.
My stem snaps and I lean sideways.
It hurts; my roots are drawing in.
I shed a few leaves.
A petal of mine was knocked loose.
I press to the ground, gasping.
Sap seeps from the break.
I wobble and can't stand firm.
You've crushed half my bloom.
I must hide in the grass and recover.
There's perfume on your clothes.
That scent is dizzyingly sweet.
What are you holding? Let me smell.
All my petals turn toward you.
That smell makes me hungry.
You've set the bottle down.
Your scent is too strong.
I stretch a stem and touch it.
I smelled this yesterday too.

lines.zh: 我忘了警惕，只想再闻一次。
lines.en: I forgot caution; I want one more breath.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，花瓣落了一地。
lines.en: You hit me and petals scatter.
I bend my stem to let you pass.

lines.zh: 我的花瓣被你撞掉一片，黑色。
lines.en: You knock a petal off me, black as ink.
You step on my root hairs.

lines.zh: 我把身子往旁边挪了挪。
lines.en: I shift my body to one side.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，花粉扑了你一脸。
lines.en: We collide and pollen powders your face.
Don't push the heart of my bloom.
I step back and the grass bends.

lines.zh: 你贴得太近了，花要合上了。
lines.en: Too close; my flower is closing.
That nearly shook me apart.

lines.zh: 另一朵花，在月光下开了。
lines.en: Another flower opens in the moonlight.
Our flower hearts face each other.
Its petals are whiter than mine.
Pollen drifts between us.
Our stems twine together.
Together we look at the moon.
The meadow smells sweet all night.
Its roots press against mine.
We don't speak; we simply bloom.
This meadow will be fuller next year.

lines.zh: 我用花瓣卷起一块东西。
lines.en: I curl a petal around something.

lines.zh: 黑色花瓣掉在地上，我收着。
lines.en: Black petals fall; I keep them.
I press this seed into the soil.
Something glows in the night.
I hide it in my flower's heart.
This is sweet; I'll keep it.
I curl around it and take it in slowly.
Someone dropped it; it's mine.
I hang it up high.
This cloth will wrap my bloom.
You carry that perfume.
I smell you. Sweet.
I turn and my flower faces you.
You trampled the whole patch.
I'm fast; you won't escape.
My petals stand up one by one.
I bloom before you on the grass.

lines.zh: 香水味在你衣领上，太明显了。
lines.en: The perfume on your collar is far too obvious.

lines.zh: 我比你快，草地又这么平。
lines.en: I am faster than you, and the meadow is so flat.

lines.zh: 花心里的眼睛已经对准你。
lines.en: The eye inside my bloom is already fixed on you.

lines.zh: 香水味在空气里，我闻到了。
lines.en: Perfume in the air. I smell it.
You take a step; I glide a stretch.
Moonlight shows you plainly.
My petals never stop moving.
Wherever you run, the grass tells me.
I turn sharply; you didn't see.

lines.zh: 再过一会儿，就到你身后。
lines.en: A moment more and I'll be behind you.
The grass is flat; it hides no one.
I open slowly.
The air is full of my scent.
My stem whips your arm.
I lunge, and petals fly.
My stem slices your sleeve open.
You step back; I press in.
Pollen bursts across your face.
I trip your feet with my roots.
My flower heart bites your wrist.
You throw me off and half my stem snaps.

lines.zh: 我在地上滑了一圈，又回来。
lines.en: I slide a circle and come back.

lines.zh: 花茎卷住你的脚踝，拉向土里。
lines.en: My stem coils around your ankle and pulls you toward the soil.
In the moonlight, a flower opens.

lines.zh: 草地忽然多了一片花瓣。
lines.en: A petal appears on the grass.

lines.zh: 夜露滴下，我就站起来了。
lines.en: Dew falls, and I stand up.

lines.zh: 我从土里钻出来，很安静。
lines.en: I come up out of the soil quietly.
This meadow smells especially sweet today.
One flower stands where it shouldn't.

lines.zh: 月亮被云遮了一下，我已经在。
lines.en: The moon dims, and I'm already here.

lines.zh: 黑色花瓣先撑开，然后才是花心。
lines.en: The black petals open first, then the heart of the flower.
The wind blew pollen here.
At night, this flower begins to move.
I raise my head slowly.

lines.zh: 草地边缘多了一个影子。
lines.en: A shadow joins the meadow's edge.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的花瓣就卷了。
lines.en: Fire touches me and my petals curl.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，花都散了。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and my bloom comes apart.
Water reaches my flower's heart and I smother.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的花瓣全掀了。
lines.en: The blast strips off all my petals.
An arrow pierces my stem.

lines.zh: 法术一照，我的花就枯了。
lines.en: One flash of that spell and my bloom withers.
This soil is poor; I can't feed.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我整株都焦了。
lines.en: A flash of lightning scorches me whole.

lines.zh: 虚空扯住我的根，往下拉。
lines.en: The void grips my roots and pulls.
